evidence.quote: According to the XRD results, both alloys possess a single BCC phase, indicating that no phase transformation occurs after the cold rolling-annealing process at different temperatures. The lattice constants of the R850 and R1050 RHEAs are 0.3385 nm and 0.3376 nm, respectively.

the relatively narrow microbands of the R1050 alloy make the work hardening rate of the alloy begin to decrease after 6% plastic deformation in stage II.
